handhold.condition: The actor flag bit 0x10 must be set and the player must be within 0x0C pixels of the handler's local Y target.
handhold.observed_effect: The handler aligns PLAYER_Y to actor_y - WORLD_CAMERA_Y - 8, then changes type 0x69/0x68 to 0x6B and publishes interaction state.

The first bounce is reached, but the player misses the next vertical route and falls into the lower death area near world X 0x06A4.
Releasing horizontal input after the first bounce still misses the next route; the player remains below the valid floor band.
